body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> While the most-talked-about categories of this year's CES is Green IT, Beone CNR, a medium-sized Korean firm, is drawing the attention of visitors with the company's eco-friendly packing materials.
(Picture: a premium packing materials designed for VIP customers of a company)
Beone CNR is a medium-sized company that has developed and produced about 400 kinds of mobile phone packing together with the wireless business department of Samsung Electronics.
(Picture: a premium packing materials shipping for Plantronics)
Beone CNR is developing packing materials that make the product images stand out by developing a higher level of design and paper materials instead of just focusing on protecting the products.

Especially the company is developing 'papier-mache structure' packing materials, and is improving productivity by doing away with the plastic tray inside and developing only with an eco-friendly paper structure.
(Picture: Hyun Yong-Uk, CEO of Beone CNR)

CEO Hyun Yong-Uk of Beone CNR said, "Beone BNR must be the only company in Korea that has the capacity to research, develop papier-mache structure, design and produce high-quality wrapping papers." He continued, "We will hit the U.S market to increase export rate of premium packing materials from 3% up to 15%," he continued.
(Picture: the front of Beone CNR booth at CES 2010)
